title: The Buddha: more places, terms, Sangha rules

boxes.title: Life: added detail
items: **Four sights**: old man, sick man, corpse, ascetic → **Mahabhinishkramana**
**Six years** of austerities with five ascetics, then abandoned
No successor: **Dhamma and Vinaya** to be the teacher

boxes.title: Sermon, disciples, epithets
items: Five companions: **Kondanna, Bhaddiya, Vappa, Mahanama, Assaji** → Arhats

boxes.title: Sangha: added
items: Women admitted at request of **Ananda** + Mahapajapati
Shaved heads, saffron robes, daily alms; democratic, power to punish
**Sanghamitta** took Bhikkhuni Sangha to Sri Lanka; lasted to Chola invasion **1017 AD**

lines: **Bavari**'s disciples (Godavari) met Buddha → faith to Andhra
